display.intent: Create the restaking config
display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.admin} creates the restaking program's config ${accounts.config}

display.intent: Register a network
display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.admin} registers network ${accounts.ncn} and becomes its admin

display.intent: Register an operator
display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.admin} registers operator ${accounts.operator} with a fee of ${data.operatorFeeBps} and becomes its admin

display.intent: Add a slasher for a vault
display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.admin} adds slasher ${accounts.slasher} for vault ${accounts.vault} to network ${accounts.ncn}, slashing at most ${data.maxSlashablePerEpoch} of the vault's token per epoch

display.intent: Add a vault to a network
display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.admin} adds vault ${accounts.vault} to network ${accounts.ncn}, creating ticket ${accounts.ncnVaultTicket}

display.intent: Add a vault to an operator
display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.admin} adds vault ${accounts.vault} to operator ${accounts.operator}, creating ticket ${accounts.operatorVaultTicket}

display.intent: Add an operator to a network
display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.admin} adds operator ${accounts.operator} to network ${accounts.ncn}, creating the state ${accounts.ncnOperatorState} through which each side opts in

display.intent: Network opts in to a vault
display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.admin} opts network ${accounts.ncn} in to vault ${accounts.vault}; it becomes active after one full epoch of warm-up

display.intent: Network opts out of a vault
display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.admin} opts network ${accounts.ncn} out of vault ${accounts.vault}; it ends after one full epoch of cooldown

display.intent: Network opts in to an operator
display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.admin} opts network ${accounts.ncn} in to operator ${accounts.operator}; it becomes active after one full epoch of warm-up

display.intent: Network opts out of an operator
display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.admin} opts network ${accounts.ncn} out of operator ${accounts.operator}; it ends after one full epoch of cooldown

display.intent: Operator opts in to a network
display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.admin} opts operator ${accounts.operator} in to network ${accounts.ncn}; it becomes active after one full epoch of warm-up

display.intent: Operator opts out of a network
display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.admin} opts operator ${accounts.operator} out of network ${accounts.ncn}; it ends after one full epoch of cooldown

display.intent: Activate a slasher for a vault
display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.admin} activates slasher ${accounts.slasher} of network ${accounts.ncn} for vault ${accounts.vault}; it becomes active after one full epoch of warm-up

display.intent: Deactivate a slasher for a vault
display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.admin} deactivates slasher ${accounts.slasher} of network ${accounts.ncn} for vault ${accounts.vault}; it ends after one full epoch of cooldown

display.intent: Operator opts in to a vault
display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.admin} opts operator ${accounts.operator} in to vault ${accounts.vault}; it becomes active after one full epoch of warm-up

display.intent: Operator opts out of a vault
display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.admin} opts operator ${accounts.operator} out of vault ${accounts.vault}; it ends after one full epoch of cooldown

display.intent: Hand over a network
display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.oldAdmin} hands the admin role of network ${accounts.ncn}, and every other role it holds there, to ${accounts.newAdmin}

display.intent: Set a network role
display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.admin} gives the ${data.ncnAdminRole} role of network ${accounts.ncn} to ${accounts.newAdmin}

display.intent: Hand over an operator
display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.oldAdmin} hands the admin role of operator ${accounts.operator}, and every other role it holds there, to ${accounts.newAdmin}

display.intent: Set an operator role
display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.admin} gives the ${data.operatorAdminRole} role of operator ${accounts.operator} to ${accounts.newAdmin}

display.intent: Set an operator's fee
display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.admin} sets the fee of operator ${accounts.operator} to ${data.newFeeBps}

display.intent: Delegate a network token account
display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.delegateAdmin} lets ${accounts.delegate} move any amount of ${accounts.tokenMint} from network ${accounts.ncn}'s token account ${accounts.tokenAccount}

display.intent: Delegate an operator token account
display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.delegateAdmin} lets ${accounts.delegate} move any amount of ${accounts.tokenMint} from operator ${accounts.operator}'s token account ${accounts.tokenAccount}

display.intent: Hand over the program config
display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.oldAdmin} hands the admin role of the restaking program's config to ${accounts.newAdmin}
